summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 7 September 2026.
Total work logged: 8h 25m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (1h 45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  5 UAE orders reported stuck; 4 now COMPLETED. 1 order (AE260812-57849665) remains at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after partial cancellation. Parallel investigation launched across Kibana, codebase, DB, and PC search. (25m)

AEME-6500 — 
  5 orders investigated. 3 resolved (stock updated, PC-52918 remediation, shipping address fixed). 2 remain stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED — one awaiting warehouse shipment, one blocked by SMC UPDATE_ERROR pending PC-53305 approval. (1h 0m)

AEME-6535 — 
  SUBS team requested 18 new SubscriptionData columns for UAE PROD Daily SC+ Report. Enhancement script created under PC-53535, reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Awaiting execution on HAC scripting console to update report script. (25m)

AEME-6540 — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Trade-in clawback payments declined by Checkout.com for 2 AE orders with REJECTED NorthLadder status. Clawback processes stuck at payment step. Awaiting confirmation on updated customer card details to re-trigger.

PC-5 — 

PC-53305 — 
  Reusable approved PC for SMC re-registration remediation, carrying script for order AE260819-63130115. Clears stale SC+ policy and re-registers. Blocked by AEME-6500; awaiting approval to execute.

PC-53535 — 
  Adds 18 SubscriptionData and payment mode columns (U-AL) to UAE PROD Daily SC+ Report script. Reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Rollback is reverting to version 44. Awaiting execution on HAC. (25m)

PC-53689 — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Adds Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report Groovy script. Script complete and attached. Deployment requires updating Script item in HAC — no build needed. Awaiting execution and verification. (1h 0m)

SAME-3960 — 
  Return blocked for completed screen repair order — GCIC service status beyond cancellable window (ST030). Hybris correctly blocks return per business logic. Options: GCIC status rollback or enable config bypass for returns. (2h 30m)

TKME-2308 — 
  17 TR-region stuck orders investigated via HAC DB verification. 5 already resolved. 12 remain across 5 root causes: FI connection errors, GetMobil NPE, refund failures, WMS dispatch blocks, and return shipping delays. No reusable PC ticket found. (20m)

TKME-2311 — 
  Master data creation for TR store C750_007_31536 (Antalya). ImpEx generated from Excel template, field-verified against source. PC-53498 created, approved, and executed successfully in production. Complete. (35m)

Open tickets:

PC-53689 [Approved-ES] — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Todo: Approved by D2C
Please validate in production, then update the comments and also monitor the performance impact as well.

AEME-6282 [In Progress] — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Todo: Hi ~@email ,

 

According to the API details, the requested amount exceeds the customer's current balance.

The custome

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAME-3958 [QA Server Review] — Sales Report - Additional Columns
  Todo: Awaiting QA review.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

AEME-6540 [In Progress] — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
